test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom or phrase to complete the given sentence.

I like her because she never likes to make _________.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4, **a**** quick buck**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A quick buck (त्वरित लाभ) **- Earning money quickly and often dishonestly suggests she values honesty and integrity over easy profits. 

 
 
• **Example: **He's always looking for a way to make a quick buck.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- a quick buck.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A slap on the wrist (हल्की सज़ा)** - A very mild punishment.

 
 
• **Example: **The shoplifter got off with just a slap on the wrist.
 
 
 
• **A drop in the bucket (बूंद में एक बूंद)** - A very small amount in comparison to what is needed.
 
 
• **Example:** The charity donation was just a drop in the bucket towards the disaster relief needs.
 
 
 
• **A bed of roses (सुख-सुविधाओं से भरपूर)** - A situation that is comfortable or easy.
 
 
• **Example:** Life is not always a bed of roses.
 
 

216:T9f2,

The correct answer is **Option 1.**
